description: Figure 2, captioned “Accuracy comparison of different models on paraphrase sentiment, and STS tasks,” is a bar chart that visually compares the performance of various models across two distinct natural language processing tasks: paraphrase sentiment classification and sentence similarity (STS) scoring. The horizontal axis, labeled “Task,” lists the two tasks in order: “Paraphrase Sentiment” and “STS.” The vertical axis, labeled “Accuracy,” is scaled linearly from 0 to 1, with tick marks at regular intervals of 0.1, indicating the proportion of correct predictions. The chart contains two bars: the first bar, corresponding to “Paraphrase Sentiment,” is colored dark gray and reaches a height of approximately 0.85 on the accuracy scale. The second bar, corresponding to “STS,” is colored light gray and reaches a height of approximately 0.92 on the accuracy scale. The bars are presented side-by-side without any grouping or stacking, and there is no indication that the bars are sorted or that any specific model is being compared; the chart appears to represent the accuracy of a single model or a baseline model across these two tasks. There are no annotations, shading, or emphasis applied to any of the bars.
